title: Platform Liveness Probe Envelope (BUILD-005 Slice 1)
description: Liveness means process/runtime vitality only. Must not represent database connectivity, Core reachability, storage pressure, queue depth, scheduler state, Capability Pack trust, delivery state, or monitored device/server state.
